SELECT AA.appr_no, AA.appr_title, AA.appr_reg_date, AA.appr_status, AA.appr_order_status, AA.relationship, AA.member_name, AA.approval_form_name, AA.approver_decision_status FROM ( SELECT W.appr_no ,W.appr_title ,W.appr_reg_date ,W.appr_status ,W.appr_order_status ,W.relationship ,M.member_name ,AF.approval_form_name ,W.approver_order, W.approver_decision_status FROM (SELECT a.appr_no , a.appr_reg_date ,a.appr_title,a.appr_status ,a.appr_order_status ,a.appr_sender ,a.approval_type_no ,'P' as relationship ,p.approver_order, p.approver_decision_status FROM `approval` a JOIN ( SELECT * FROM `appr_approver` WHERE approver_no = #{member_no}) p ON a.appr_no = p.appr_no UNION SELECT a.appr_no , a.appr_reg_date ,a.appr_title ,a.appr_status ,a.appr_order_status ,a.appr_sender ,a.approval_type_no ,'A' as relationship ,1 AS approver_order, t.agreementer_agree_status AS approver_decision_status FROM `approval` a JOIN (SELECT * FROM `appr_agreementer` WHERE agreementer_no = #{member_no}) t ON a.appr_no = t.appr_no UNION SELECT a.appr_no , a.appr_reg_date ,a.appr_title ,a.appr_status ,a.appr_order_status ,a.appr_sender ,a.approval_type_no ,'R' AS relationship ,1 AS approver_order, r.referencer_status AS approver_decision_status FROM `approval` a JOIN (SELECT * FROM `appr_referencer` WHERE referencer_no = #{member_no}) r ON a.appr_no = r.appr_no ) W JOIN `member` M ON W.appr_sender = M.member_no JOIN `approval_form` AF ON W.approval_type_no = AF.approval_form_no ) AA
AND AA.appr_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_text}, '%')
AND AA.member_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_text}, '%')
AND AA.approval_form_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_text}, '%')
AND AA.relationship = 'P' AND AA.approver_order = AA.appr_order_status AND (AA.approver_decision_status = 'W' OR AA.approver_decision_status IS NULL) AND AA.appr_status NOT IN ('C', 'R')
AND (AA.appr_status = 'C' OR AA.approver_decision_status = 'C')
AND AA.relationship = #{search_status}
AND AA.appr_reg_date >= CONCAT(#{start_date}, ' 00:00:00')
AND AA.appr_reg_date <= CONCAT(#{end_date}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY AA.appr_reg_date DESC
ORDER BY AA.appr_reg_date ASC
ORDER BY AA.appr_reg_date DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN W.relationship = 'P' AND W.approver_order = W.appr_order_status AND (W.approver_decision_status = 'W' OR W.approver_decision_status IS NULL) AND W.appr_status NOT IN ('C', 'R') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS P_count, SUM(CASE WHEN W.relationship = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS A_count, SUM(CASE WHEN W.relationship = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS R_count, SUM(CASE WHEN W.appr_status = 'C' OR W.approver_decision_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS C_count FROM ( SELECT a.appr_no, a.appr_status, a.appr_order_status, 'P' AS relationship, p.approver_order, p.approver_decision_status FROM `approval` a JOIN ( SELECT * FROM `appr_approver` WHERE approver_no = #{member_no} ) p ON a.appr_no = p.appr_no
UNION ALL
SELECT a.appr_no, a.appr_status, a.appr_order_status, 'A' AS relationship, 1 AS approver_order, t.agreementer_agree_status AS approver_decision_status FROM `approval` a JOIN (SELECT * FROM `appr_agreementer` WHERE agreementer_no = #{member_no}) t ON a.appr_no = t.appr_no
UNION ALL
SELECT a.appr_no, a.appr_status, a.appr_order_status, 'R' AS relationship, 1 AS approver_order, 'R' AS approver_decision_status FROM `approval` a JOIN (SELECT * FROM `appr_referencer` WHERE referencer_no = #{member_no}) r ON a.appr_no = r.appr_no ) W;
